Table "public.email_otps"
       Column       |           Type           | Collation | Nullable |                 Default                 
--------------------+--------------------------+-----------+----------+-----------------------------------------
 _id                | bigint                   |           | not null | nextval('email_otps__id_seq'::regclass)
 _created_at        | timestamp with time zone |           | not null | now()
 _updated_at        | timestamp with time zone |           | not null | now()
 _school__id        | bigint                   |           | not null | 
 email_address      | email_address            |           | not null | 
 otp_hash           | bytes32                  |           | not null | 
 attempts_remaining | integer                  |           | not null | 3
 expires_at         | timestamp with time zone |           | not null | 
Indexes:
    "email_otps_pkey" PRIMARY KEY, btree (_id)
    "idx_email_otps_email_school" btree (email_address, _school__id)
Foreign-key constraints:
    "email_otps__school__id_fkey" FOREIGN KEY (_school__id) REFERENCES schools(_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
Triggers:
    trggr_email_otps__updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON email_otps FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update__updated_at()
